top_signals.title: EM Stocks Jump to Highest Since June as Tech Offsets Higher Oil
top_signals.summary: An index tracking emerging-market equities rallied at the start of the week, closing at its highest level in more than two months, as optimism over new AI models helped counter the drag from increased oil prices.

top_signals.title: ‘Utter devastation’ from Amazon cargo jet crash, NTSB chief says
top_signals.summary:
Freight and passenger delays could mount this week at Miami International Airport where two runways remain shut as the recovery operations and an investigation into Sunday’s deadly crash landing of an Amazon cargo jet continue.

top_signals.title: China Halts New Battery Storage Plant Approvals
top_signals.summary: China has paused approvals for new battery storage factories amid a review of existing and planned capacity, Chinese financial news outlet Cailianshe reported this weekend, citing industry sources. The temporary suspension of approvals of plants that have not started construction yet comes amid growing concerns about overcapacity in the sector in the world’s biggest manufacturer of batteries for energy storage.
